failure.message: The formatter palette uses NSMassFormatter, but the host packaged GNUstep Foundation headers do not declare that class.

next_actions.message: Retry Gorm in a managed toolchain lane whose GNUstep Base headers include NSMassFormatter.

If older distro-packaged GNUstep remains a supported Gorm build target, carry an upstreamable compatibility patch that disables or guards the Mass Formatter palette when NSMassFormatter is unavailable.
After a binary artifact exists, prove server-profile rejection and desktop-profile install/launch/remove behavior.
